Why worth posting: the post treats the training data as neutral; that is the whole question, and it is checkable.

Draft:
A screen trained on past hires reproduces whoever got hired before. The 2018 Amazon resume tool is the cited example -- it downgraded resumes containing "women's" because that is what the history contained. Bias moves from the interviewer to the training set; it does not leave the system.
